name: handoff-nudge
description: A band above the prompt that suggests a handoff when the context window passes a threshold. One press has the model write a short focus line and fills /handoff with it; once the handoff mod has saved the note, the band offers /clear and points at /handoff resume.

thresholdPct.title: Threshold (% of context window)
thresholdPct.description: Show the band once the context holds this share of the model's window.

thresholdTokens.title: Threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: An absolute token count that replaces the percentage. 0 uses the percentage.
